posts.zh:
dsh-swarm-router 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。子智能体矩阵蜂群：把异质任务路由到最合适的模型（OpenRouter 类网关 + cfgpu.com/llm/square），通过进程内子智能体或直接 LLM 调用下放，并按模型统计 token 消耗、用真实反馈驱动排名。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-252aa76e945fb8a4a02f.html
posts.en:
dsh-swarm-router is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Sub-agent matrix swarm that routes heterogeneous tasks to the most suitable model from an OpenRouter-like gateway plus cfgpu.com/llm/square, dispatches each via in-process subagents or direct LLM calls, and tracks per-model token consumption with a feedback-driven ranking.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-252aa76e945fb8a4a02f.html
